beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The people everyone else had written off — the cheats, the outcasts, the ones with a past — kept crowding in close to hear Jesus.

timing.text: The people everyone else had written off — the cheats, the outcasts, the ones with a past — kept crowding in close to hear Jesus.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And the religious men muttered about it.

timing.text: And the religious men muttered about it.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: This man receiveth sinners, and eateth with them.

timing.text: This man receiveth sinners, and eateth with them.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This man welcomes sinners, they said, and even eats with them.

timing.text: This man welcomes sinners, they said, and even eats with them.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: So Jesus told them a story about how heaven really feels about one lost person.

timing.text: So Jesus told them a story about how heaven really feels about one lost person.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?

timing.text: What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Which of you, he asks, with a hundred sheep, would not leave the ninety-nine behind to go after the one that wandered off, and keep searching until you found it?

timing.text: Which of you, he asks, with a hundred sheep, would not leave the ninety-nine behind to go after the one that wandered off, and keep searching until you found it?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He does not stand there counting what he still has. He leaves the ninety-nine behind to go out after the one that is gone.

timing.text: He does not stand there counting what he still has.
He leaves the ninety-nine behind to go out after the one that is gone.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He searches through the night, over the rocks and the ravines, calling into the dark, because to him that one is not a loss he can shrug off. That one is his.

timing.text: He searches through the night, over the rocks and the ravines, calling into the dark, because to him that one is not a loss he can shrug off.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And when he finds it — frightened, tangled in the thorns, too worn out to walk — he does not scold it, and he does not leave it there.

timing.text: And when he finds it — frightened, tangled in the thorns, too worn out to walk — he does not scold it, and he does not leave it there.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: And when he hath found it, he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

timing.text: And when he hath found it, he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He lifts it up, lays it across his own shoulders, and carries it the whole way home, rejoicing. Not relieved. Not annoyed at the trouble. Rejoicing.

timing.text: He lifts it up, lays it across his own shoulders, and carries it the whole way home, rejoicing.
Not relieved.
Not annoyed at the trouble.
Rejoicing.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then he calls everyone together — friends, neighbors, the whole village — and throws a celebration.

timing.text: Then he calls everyone together — friends, neighbors, the whole village — and throws a celebration.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.

timing.text: Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Be glad with me, he tells them. Not, I got my property back. It was his the whole time it was missing.

timing.text: Be glad with me, he tells them.
Not, I got my property back.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.

timing.text: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That is how good he is. Heaven throws a party over one person turning back. Not a lecture. Not a grudge. Joy.

timing.text: That is how good he is.

card.text: To him, you were never one of a crowd. Have you ever felt like the one who wandered too far to be worth coming after?
